en.summary: Mixed commit: one real L1 DCache handshake fix plus an MMU-disable workaround. The reusable bug fix is that miss-response source metadata is now captured only when the request queue actually dequeues.
why_it_counts: The functional change is in the L1 DCache miss path, not in tests or tooling.
The fix changes a queue guard from valid to fire, which is a concrete ready/valid correctness repair.
The commit message explicitly reports an L1 cache stall bug.
disqualifiers: The same commit also changes MMU_ENABLED from true to false in parameters.scala, which is a workload workaround rather than the portable DUT fix.
evidence: In ventus/src/L1Cache/DCache/DCache.scala, the read-path assignment of memReq_st3.a_source changes from memReq_Q.io.deq.valid to memReq_Q.io.deq.fire.
The changed line sits in the stage that latches metadata used to route the memory response back to the requester.
The only other hunk is the unrelated MMU_ENABLED toggle in ventus/src/top/parameters.scala.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a pipelined cache miss path, request metadata that will later identify the returning response must advance only when the queue handshake completes. If source or tag metadata is sampled when a queue entry is merely valid but not accepted, a stalled dequeue can prematurely overwrite or reuse metadata from the wrong miss, which can stall the cache or misroute the response.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A miss request is visible at the head of a queue while downstream backpressure prevents the dequeue from firing.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Update response-routing metadata on queue valid instead of on dequeue fire.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: weaken handshake guard from fire to valid on a metadata latch
portability_notes: Apply this to any queue or pipeline register that carries miss identifiers, source IDs, or response-routing tags.
The bug is most portable in designs where response routing depends on metadata copied out of a queue head.
Do not couple the injected fault to Ventus-specific signal names; the key is advancing metadata without a completed handshake.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the cache stage that copies miss metadata from a request queue into the outgoing memory request record.
Locate the guard that should require both valid and ready, or an explicit fire condition, before the metadata register updates.
Replace that guard with a weaker valid-only condition so the metadata updates even when the queue head is stalled.
Keep the rest of the dequeue logic unchanged so only the metadata timing becomes inconsistent.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L1 DCache stage-3 memReq a_source capture
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the read-side memReq_st3.a_source update so it occurs only on memReq_Q.io.deq.fire, matching the queue handshake.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert the read-path guard around memReq_st3.a_source so it uses memReq_Q.io.deq.valid instead of memReq_Q.io.deq.fire.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under backpressure, the cache can associate a returning miss response with stale or premature source metadata, causing response misrouting or an L1 stall/deadlock.
evidence_for_injection: The patch changes only the dequeue qualifier on the read-path metadata latch.
The same block already uses deq.fire for the write-side source construction, which reinforces that the read-side should obey the same handshake rule.
The commit message describes a stall symptom that matches incorrect queue-handshake timing.
notes: Use the DCache handshake hunk as the injected fault; ignore the MMU configuration toggle.
This is a small reverse edit and is suitable for fault injection without reconstructing the whole mixed commit.

zh.summary: 这是一个混合提交：其中既有真实的 L1 DCache 握手修复，也有关闭 MMU 的工作负载绕过。可复用的缺陷修复点是：只有在请求队列真正 dequeue 时，才更新 miss 返回路径使用的 source 元数据。
why_it_counts: 功能性修改位于 L1 DCache 的 miss 路径，而不是测试或工具层。
该修复把队列条件从 valid 改为 fire，是明确的 ready/valid 正确性修复。
提交说明直接指出了 L1 cache stall bug。
disqualifiers: 同一提交还在 parameters.scala 中把 MMU_ENABLED 从 true 改为 false，这更像工作负载绕过，而不是可移植的 DUT 修复。
evidence: 在 ventus/src/L1Cache/DCache/DCache.scala 中，给 memReq_st3.a_source 赋值的读路径条件从 memReq_Q.io.deq.valid 改成了 memReq_Q.io.deq.fire。
修改位置位于将元数据锁存到发往内存请求的那一级，用于后续把返回响应路由回原请求者。
另一处改动只是 ventus/src/top/parameters.scala 中无关的 MMU_ENABLED 开关。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在带流水的 cache miss 路径中，之后用于匹配返回响应的请求元数据只能在队列握手真正完成时推进。如果 source 或 tag 等元数据在队列只是 valid 但还未被接受时就被采样，那么停顿中的 dequeue 会过早覆盖或复用错误 miss 的元数据，进而导致 cache 停顿或响应路由错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 按 dequeue 握手推进的 miss 元数据捕获
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: miss 请求位于队列头部，但下游反压导致 dequeue 不能 fire。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在队列 valid 时就更新响应路由元数据，而不是等 dequeue fire 后再更新。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 把元数据锁存的握手条件从 fire 弱化成 valid
portability_notes: 可映射到任何携带 miss 标识、source ID 或响应路由 tag 的队列或流水寄存器。
在依赖队列头元数据进行返回响应路由的设计里，这类缺陷最容易复现。
不要依赖 Ventus 的局部信号名；关键是“握手未完成时元数据先推进”。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 cache 中把 miss 元数据从请求队列复制到外发内存请求记录的那一级。
找到要求 valid 和 ready 同时成立，或显式 fire，才更新元数据寄存器的保护条件。
把这个条件改成更弱的 valid-only，使队列头停顿时元数据也会更新。
保持其余 dequeue 逻辑不变，只制造元数据时序不一致。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L1 DCache 第 3 级 memReq 的 a_source 捕获逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复将读侧 memReq_st3.a_source 的更新条件改成 memReq_Q.io.deq.fire，使其与队列真实握手保持一致。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 将 memReq_st3.a_source 读路径上的条件改回 memReq_Q.io.deq.valid，而不是 memReq_Q.io.deq.fire。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在反压条件下，cache 可能把返回 miss 响应关联到陈旧或过早更新的 source 元数据，导致响应错配，或者触发 L1 停顿/死锁。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁只修改了读路径元数据锁存时使用的 dequeue 条件。
同一代码块中写路径本来就使用 deq.fire，说明读路径也应遵守相同的握手规则。
提交信息描述的是 stall 症状，与错误的队列握手时序高度一致。
notes: 故障注入应选择 DCache 握手这一处，不要使用 MMU 配置切换。
这是一个很小的逆向修改，适合直接用于 fault injection。
